answer: An identity must be at least 3 epochs old on the marble ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the crystal checkpoint rather than self-declared, the ferrous audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm as a result means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
